title: Utho abbas
body:
Utho abbas
(Ya abbas) x2
<<MINI>>
(haye abbas utho) x2
(utho abbas bahan waqife-e bazaar nahi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek bhatija ke siwa koi madadgar nahi
<<MINI>>
(utho abbas bahan waqife-e bazaar nahi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Sham jaana hai rida sar pe nahi hai bhaya
<<MINI>>
(haye abbas utho) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Dile gham zadaa kare ye buka, Behan ka nahi koi aasra, (utho abbas bahan waqife-e bazaar nahi) x2
Ghar se nikli thi to mehmil me bithaya tune
<<MINI>>
(haye abbas utho) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Safar dusra shuroo hai mera, Chali chawd ke behan karbela, (utho abbas bahan waqife-e bazaar nahi) x2
Mayne yasrab ki bhi galiya na kabhi dekhi thi
<<MINI>>
(haye abbas utho) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Behan kya kare milenge mujhe, Naye log or naye raste, (utho abbas bahan waqife-e bazaar nahi) x2
maa ki tarha se mein darbare sitam jawoongi
<<MINI>>
(haye abbas utho) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
bataawo zaraa mere bawafaa, garibul watan kare kya bhala
<<MINI>>
(utho abbas bahan waqife-e bazaar nahi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
samne kaise me shiri ka karungi socho
<<MINI>>
(haye abbas utho) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
karoo mein fugaa bandhi reshwa, huwi kayd sab nabi zaadiya, (utho abbas bahan waqife-e bazaar nahi) x2
kya gawaara hein ke sab dekhe khule sar mujko
<<MINI>>
(haye abbas utho) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
duwa do mujhe sikha do mujhe, chaloo kis tarha bataado mujhe, (utho abbas bahan waqife-e bazaar nahi) x2
shimr marega sakina ko behan royengi
<<MINI>>
(haye abbas utho) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
kerenge sitam laeen har kadam, tu hein har kadam bhulayenge hum
<<MINI>>
(utho abbas bahan waqife-e bazaar nahi) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise jayengi nabizadi sitam gharo mein
